name: Botvrij.eu blocklist
tier_rationale: Public anti-botnet initiative publishing MISP-derived indicator lists with documentation (A8 community); the P071 chair rates list maintainers community.

reliability.justification: MISP-derived indicators with event context; the full blocklist has not changed since 2021-10-06 (Last-Modified), so every hit is historical.

blocklist_full.title: Botvrij.eu full domain blocklist (CSV: value, decay score, type, event id, event info)

terms.quote: Per-feed terms: CERT.PL Hole (any use incl. commercial; trusted), Phishing.Database (MIT), StevenBlack (MIT), MetaMask eth-phishing-detect (permissive), spmedia (MIT), Botvrij, CyberCrime-Tracker and Procon-SP run with attribution. HaGeZi TIF and ScamSniffer are GPL-3.0 data: runtime download only, never bundled or used as fixtures (A6).

blocklist_full.notes: Quote: binding council text (P071 cond 2: run with attribution). https://www.botvrij.eu/data/blocklist/blocklist_full.csv (~385 KB); frozen since 2021-10-06, so hits are always historical (P071 cond 8).
